description: Congestion management activations - Cross-border redispatching - data up to 22/05/2024 is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Commission Regulation (EU) n° 543/2013 on submission and publication of data in electricity markets defines the concept of Redispatching as follows: Measure activated by one or several system operators by altering the generation and/or load pattern in order to change physical flows in the transmission system and relieve a physical congestion. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Congestion management. Its keywords are Activations, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
